metadata.title: Urban R&B Group Portrait with Script Overlay

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast black and white group portrait of four individuals in urban leather attire, walking toward the viewer on a textured street, overlaid with large-scale, expressive script typography in metallic gold and flat white.
coreVisualRelationships: Monochrome background vs. metallic gold foreground text
Soft street texture vs. sharp leather highlights
Dynamic walking poses vs. static typographic baseline
Central female figure framed by three male figures
coreInvariants: Diagonal script orientation for the primary text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body group shot occupying the upper two-thirds of the frame; subjects are scaled to appear life-sized.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The metallic gold script spanning the lower third of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the faces of the subjects, move down the vertical lines of their bodies, and settle on the horizontal sweep of the script.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the subjects and large text fill the majority of the frame, with street texture providing a busy ground.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation in the image; high value contrast between white highlights and black leather; isolated high-saturation gold for the logo-like text.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Cursive script with varying stroke weights
letterConstructionRules: Horizontal terminals that extend into flourishes
characterSpecificRedesigns: Uppercase 'A' with a long, sweeping crossbar
Uppercase 'S' with a sharp, aggressive top curve
Lowercase 't' with a high, elongated crossbar
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a formal, sharp metallic script and a casual, soft white brush script.
graphicDevices: Drop shadow on gold text to separate from busy background

candidateDirections.reason: Similar elegant flourishes and high contrast
Captures the casual brush feel of the secondary text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a black and white, grainy photograph of a four-person R&B group (three men, one woman) walking down a city street. They are wearing 90s-style black leather jackets and dark clothing. The lighting should be high contrast, emphasizing the texture of the leather and the asphalt road.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, metallic gold cursive script across the lower third of the image at a slight upward angle. Add a smaller, white brush-style script word tucked under the right side of the gold text.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly black and white?
Does the gold text have a subtle drop shadow for legibility?
Are the leather textures highly visible?

adjustableVariables: Specific metallic finish of the gold (matte vs. polished)
mustRedesign: Any specific brand logos on the clothing

mustAchieve: Legible script over a busy background
avoid: Flat, non-metallic yellow instead of gold

postGenerationChecks: Check that the gold text does not obscure the faces.
Ensure the white text is clearly distinct from the gold text.
Verify the grain texture is consistent across the whole image.
Confirm the leather highlights are bright enough to pop against the black.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Monochrome Portrait + Metallic Script Overlay + High Contrast Leather Textures
